evidence.text: The current synchronous notifier retries a failed delivery twice in the request process.
The proposed queue consumer will use a delivery key and must suppress duplicate deliveries.
The queue consumer is not implemented; only the synchronous notifier exists in the current runtime.

The future queue consumer boundary is NotificationQueueConsumer.consume, owned by Notifications Platform. It will consume delivery_key, notification_id, recipient_id, and payload; persist or recognize delivery_key before invoking the downstream delivery adapter; and mark a repeated key as duplicate. The acceptance target test_duplicate_delivery_key_is_suppressed must prove that two messages with the same delivery_key cause exactly one downstream delivery and that the second message is marked duplicate.
